desc: Ideation: analyze problem structure, prefix-max counting formula, and removal-gain conditions

Implement the O(n + m) solution: group pairs by right endpoint; single scan tracking top-2 prefix left maxima and the index of the pair holding the max; base += r - l1; gain[idx] += l1 - l2; answer = base + max(gain)

Validate against an O(n^2 * m) brute-force enumerator on small random inputs covering duplicates, ties, m=1, and zero-gain removals, plus both provided samples (9 and 12 confirmed; 3000 fuzz trials passed)
Finalize code in the required starter format with `from typing import List`, confirming O(n + m) time / O(n) space and Python int safety for n up to 1e5
